name: edworking-mcp
description: Connect Edworking tasks, Docs, projects, conversations and files to your assistant.

interface.longDescription: Read accessible workspace content and search indexed tasks, Docs, files and project messages. Create tasks and Docs; update task status, priority, assignees and dates; make targeted Markdown edits to task descriptions and Docs. Send requested messages and import public files with matching permissions. Search is ranked and bounded; indexing may lag. Requires an Edworking account and browser authorization with a dedicated scoped token.
defaultPrompt: Show the tasks in my launch project.
Create a task to review the proposal, due Friday.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only projects accessible in the connected demo workspace, with links and pagination.

positive.prompt: Show tasks in Launch with their deadlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project ID, then list its task names, deadlines, statuses and source links.
